description: Enumerated from the player's own request and judged by the pinned engine (ADR-006, `choices.ts`, `choice-judge.ts`). The golden choice corpus covers preview, every target type in the format's move pool, Mega, forced switches, conflicting switches, visible and hidden trapping, Imprison (`maybeDisabled`/`maybeLocked`), a fainted active with no replacement, a locked move and Revival Blessing (the `reviving` forced switch: the reviving slot names a fainted Pokémon, and passes only when no living bench Pokémon exists; two flagged slots at once fail closed); a brute-force oracle finds no engine-accepted action outside the enumerated set. `maybeLocked` is reached only with `maybeDisabled` (the engine derives one from the other outside gen 1), so the Imprison case covers both. The oracle leaves out engine auto-choice (`default`), which ADR-006 never offers. Unverified: no in-game fixture yet.
